title: 'Worst-Kept Secret'? Noem Explodes at Affair Questioning - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago The rumor mill roared as Rep. Jared Moskowitz grilled Kristi Noem over Corey Lewandowski’s status, needling what insiders dub D.C.’s “worst-kept secret.” Noem snapped back, calling the allegations “insane” tabloid fodder she’s denied for years—and fired off a broader charge that the left targets conservative women as either “stupid” or “s---s.”
Outside the chamber, relatives of her husband Bryon told the New York Post they hope he finally walks, saying his faith-driven duty has kept him by her side despite “humiliation.” Bryon reportedly slipped out before the Corey questioning—an image that has family members fuming. The political fallout is real: Donald Trump announced Noem’s ouster as Homeland Security secretary, and Corey reportedly departed the agency too. Whether this storm breaks the marriage remains unknown—but the headlines aren’t letting up.
